passage: Last Saturday, my friend and I decided to climb a small mountain near our city. Although the weather report said it would rain in the afternoon, we set off early in the morning because we wanted to reach the top before lunch. We put on light jackets and packed water, bread, and fruit in our bags. At the foot of the mountain, an old guide warned us that the path was steep and that we should walk slowly. We followed his advice and climbed step by step. Halfway up, we stopped beside a clear stream and rested for twenty minutes. My friend slipped on a wet stone, but he caught a tree branch and laughed at himself. When we reached the top, the clouds moved away and the sun shone over the valley. We sat on a large rock, ate our bread, and took many photos of the lake below. On the way down, we picked up empty bottles left by other climbers and put them in a bag. We returned home tired but happy, and we promised to climb a higher mountain next spring.

shadow_sentences.text: We climbed a small mountain near our city last Saturday.
The sun shone over the valley when we reached the top.
We felt tired but happy when we returned home.

coach_rationale: 今天继续盯本周重点：过去式 -ed 结尾听辨，同时加练你 EnglishPod365 笔记里暴露的连读弱项——passage 里埋了 set off、put on、picked up 三组动词短语连读靶子，听写时 -ed 的 /t/、/d/ 音不要漏。B1 第三天，继续用 although/because 复合句加压，话题换成没练过的登山郊游。

vocab.note: 短语动词连读靶子：t 滑进 off，听成 setoff 一个词
连读靶子：t 接 on，put 的 t 很轻
-ed 读 /t/，picked up 是本周连读靶子，t 滑进 up
-ed 在浊音后读 /d/，别漏掉尾音
-ed 在清音后读 /t/，slipped 别听成 slip
catch 的过去式，不规则，别听成 coat
-ed 读 /t/，三个音节别吞掉中间元音
-ed 在浊音后读 /d/，b 不发音，climb 的 b 是哑音
